battle.name: 希腊內戰
battle.brief: 1944年開始的希臘內戰以希臘本土為主要戰場，政府軍與反抗武裝在城市與鄉村持續交火。希臘軍隊曾沿用早期採購的Winchester Model 1873惠氏步槍；該型號自1873年服役，屬槓桿式連發步槍，適合步兵作戰，並曾配置於城鄉地區的步兵部隊。

kit.name: 惠氏步槍
kit.history: Winchester Model 1873是希臘軍隊早期引進的槓桿式連發步槍，1944年仍屬舊式步兵武器，與制式栓動步槍並存，並非當時最新的主力型號。

countries: 1944年的希臘內戰，主要交戰雙方是英國支持的希臘王國政府與希臘人民解放陣線EAM及其武裝組織ELAS。英國並非希臘的交戰盟國，卻以駐希部隊、軍火、沿海運輸與技術顧問直接介入；希臘政府軍包括王國陸軍、治安部隊及地方忠於政府的武裝。義大利與德國在1943年仍是ELAS的敵手，義軍投降後留下的武器成為雙方都能取得的裝備，1944年已不再是主戰線。EAM在伯羅奔尼撒、阿提卡、埃維亞、馬其頓、色薩利與伊庇魯斯各有不同支部，控制區隨英軍推進和地方協議而變動，並非固定國界。1944年9月形成的全國解放陣線與政府軍合作，10月後又轉為主要反共武裝；南斯拉夫沿希臘邊境向ELAS提供補給與庇護，但未以希臘部隊身分參戰。
countriesEn: The principal belligerents in the Greek Civil War in 1944 were the British-backed Kingdom of Greece government and the National Liberation Front, or EAM, together with its armed organization, ELAS. Britain was not a Greek allied government, but intervened directly through its forces in Greece, weapons, coastal transport, and technical advisers. The Greek government side comprised the Royal Hellenic Army, security units, and locally pro-government armed groups. Italy and Germany had still been enemies of ELAS in 1943; weapons left after the Italian capitulation became available to both sides, and they were no longer the main front in 1944. EAM had different branches in the Peloponnese, Attica, Euboea, Macedonia, Thessaly, and Epirus, and its controlled areas shifted with British advances and local agreements rather than forming a fixed frontier. The National Liberation Front, formed in September 1944, initially cooperated with the government and then became the principal anti-communist armed organization. Yugoslavia supplied and sheltered ELAS along the Greek frontier but did not enter Greece as a Greek formation.
people: 關鍵人物分屬政治領導、游擊指揮與英希政府三個層面。EAM中央委員會的重要成員包括伊利亞斯·察科格盧、伊萬尼斯·帕薩利迪斯與塔納西斯·普利斯；ELAS軍事領導則以拿破崙·帕帕塔納索普洛斯、阿里斯·韋盧奇奧蒂斯和揚尼斯·戈爾察里斯最具代表性，前者參與中央軍事統籌，後兩人長期在色薩利指揮游擊隊。安德烈亞斯·察卡洛托斯在1944年12月的雅典戰鬥中負責EAM市區武裝，戰後轉入地下。英國方面，羅納德·福布斯·亞當中將主持駐希部隊，亨利·梅特蘭·威爾遜中將則是英軍中東戰區總指揮；希臘方面，喬治·帕潘德雷歐在1944年4月前主持內閣，4月由喬治·帕帕戈斯出任首相，並以恢復王國行政控制作為政府軍的主要目標。1946年後，馬科斯·瓦菲亞迪斯接掌後來成立的人民民主軍，成為北部對政府的主要軍事領袖。
peopleEn: The principal figures belonged to three overlapping layers of political leadership, insurgent command, and the British and Greek governments. Important members of the EAM Central Committee included Ilias Tsakoglou, Ioannis Passalidis, and Thanasis Poulis. The leading ELAS military figures included Napoleon Papathanasopoulos, Aris Velouchiotis, and Yannis Gortsaris. Papathanasopoulos participated in the central military organization, while Velouchiotis and Gortsaris commanded guerrilla forces in Thessaly for an extended period. Andreas Tsakalotos organized the EAM urban armed forces during the fighting in Athens in December 1944 and subsequently went underground. On the British side, Lieutenant-General Ronald Forbes Adam commanded the British forces in Greece, while Lieutenant-General Henry Maitland Wilson commanded the Middle East theatre. In Greece, George Papandreou headed the government until April 1944, when George Papagos became prime minister and made the restoration of royal administrative control a principal government objective. After 1946, Markos Vafiadis took command of the Democratic Army of Greece that was established later and became the principal military leader confronting the government in northern Greece.
kits: 雙方裝備大量來自前盟軍繳獲物、軸心軍遺留武器與英國援助。ELAS可取得的步槍包括1895年列裝的Mannlicher M1895、1901年列裝的Mannlicher M1901，均使用8x57公厘R彈藥；1891年列裝的Carcano M91使用6.5x55公厘；1935年列裝的Mauser Kar 98k使用7.92x57公厘。自動武器包括1938年的Beretta M38、1940年的MP40與1941年的Sten Mk II，均為9x19公厘；另有繳獲的MG42，提供7.92x57公厘火力。政府軍與英軍使用Lee-Enfield No.4 Mk I步槍、Bren Mk I輕機槍及同樣為.303英制彈藥，並能取得繳獲的義德制式武器。英軍重火力包括QF 25-pounder野戰砲、QF 6-pounder反戰車砲、17-pounder反戰車砲與3-inch反戰車砲；裝甲包括Churchill Mk V、Sherman M4A1與M3 Stuart。輕型車輛有1940年Universal Carrier、1939年Humber Scout Car及Austin 3-ton四輪驅動車。實彈供應必須把6.5x55、.303、9公厘、7.92與8x57公厘R分開標定；英軍以港口、卡車和沿海公路輸送重砲、燃料與備件，ELAS則靠分散庫存、接力運輸與馬匹維持山地支隊。
kitsEn: Equipment on both sides came heavily from captured Allied matériel, weapons left by the Axis, and British deliveries. Rifles available to ELAS included the Mannlicher M1895, fielded in 1895, and Mannlicher M1901, fielded in 1901, both using 8x57mmR ammunition; the Carcano M91, fielded in 1891, using 6.5x55mm; and the Mauser Kar 98k, fielded in 1935, using 7.92x57mm. Automatic weapons included the Beretta M38 of 1938, MP40 of 1940, and Sten Mk II of 1941, all in 9x19mm. Captured MG42 machine guns also supplied 7.92x57mm firepower. Government and British troops used the Lee-Enfield No.4 Mk I rifle and Bren Mk I light machine gun, both firing .303 British ammunition, and could also obtain captured Italian and German weapons. British heavy weapons included the QF 25-pounder field gun, QF 6-pounder anti-tank gun, 17-pounder anti-tank gun, and 3-inch anti-tank gun. Armour included the Churchill Mk V, Sherman M4A1, and M3 Stuart. Light vehicles included the 1940 Universal Carrier, 1939 Humber Scout Car, and Austin 3-ton four-wheel-drive truck. Ammunition had to be separately accounted for in 6.5x55mm, .303, 9mm, 7.92mm, and 8x57mmR. The British moved heavy guns, fuel, and spare parts through ports, trucks, and coastal roads, while ELAS maintained mountain detachments through dispersed stocks, relay transport, and pack animals.
tactics: ELAS的作戰以分散的小型游擊支隊為核心，通常先攻擊城鎮外圍的警察所、治安哨與孤立交通點，再以山路和夜間移動轉入新位置。面對公路車隊時，支隊會選擇彎道、橋頭、峽口與居民區邊緣設置路障，從兩側以步槍、輕機槍及手榴彈攻擊車隊側翼；完成襲擊後迅速分散，避免被英軍裝甲車和砲火包圍。ELAS缺乏能持續壓制的重砲、標準車隊與統一後勤，因此常把彈藥分散在山區據點，並在地方支部之間調配。英國與希臘政府軍則採公路中心的戰術，以工兵清理路障，由砲兵固定道路兩側，裝甲步兵沿特里波利斯至科林斯、科林斯至埃德薩等主幹線推進，再占領車站、橋梁與城鎮；空軍和海軍沿岸砲火用於封鎖游擊隊退路。1944年12月雅典戰鬥中，EAM武裝利用街壘、反戰車障礙與高地射擊位置阻斷英軍車隊，英軍則以坦克直射火力和步兵逐區清理路口。這種戰法使政府軍能奪取交通線，卻難以在廣大山區持久占領。
tacticsEn: ELAS based its operations on small, dispersed guerrilla detachments. These usually attacked police stations, security posts, and isolated transport points around towns before withdrawing into the mountains by night. When attacking road convoys, units selected bends, bridges, passes, and the edges of built-up areas for roadblocks, then fired into the flanks of the convoy with rifles, light machine guns, and grenades before dispersing to avoid envelopment by British armour and artillery. Lacking sustained heavy artillery, standard transport, and unified logistics, ELAS distributed ammunition among mountain depots and moved supplies between local formations. The British and Greek government forces used road-centred tactics. Engineers cleared roadblocks, artillery fixed both sides of the main routes, armoured infantry advanced along the Tripoli-Corinth and Corinth-Edessa axes, and isolated detachments occupied stations, bridges, and towns. Air power and naval gunfire along the coast helped seal insurgent escape routes. During the fighting in Athens in December 1944, EAM fighters used barricades, anti-tank obstacles, and elevated firing positions to obstruct British columns, while British tanks used direct fire and infantry cleared intersections block by block. This approach gave the government control of transport routes but made lasting occupation of the extensive mountainous interior difficult.
data: 關鍵時間線如下：1944年2月27日，ELAS攻入特里波利斯，切斷伯羅奔尼撒內部聯絡，並向科林斯方向推進；3月4日起，ELAS攻擊科林斯，英軍第4印度師與希臘政府軍沿科林斯至克西洛卡斯特羅沿海公路、特里波利斯至科林斯公路反擊，英軍海軍沿岸砲火與裝甲車隊掩護步兵，迅速恢復科林斯周邊控制。4月5日以後，ELAS在埃德薩、卡爾帕基及馬其頓東部多路進攻，英軍以埃德薩公路、卡爾帕基山口和薩洛尼卡交通線為支撐點，至4月下旬重新連接前後方。英軍在5月下旬至6月以Cling作戰撤出大批人員與裝備；6月23日簽署解除武裝協定，南方ELAS大部解散，馬其頓部分武裝拒絕交出武器。9月EAM被排除於倫敦會議之外，10月3日退出政府聯合陣線，兩邊重新武力對抗。12月3日，EAM在雅典的集會與治安部隊發生衝突，街壘隨之形成；12月21日至22日，英軍裝甲撤離車隊在通往梅加拉一線遭EAM武裝伏擊，12月23日經英希雙方安排停火，EAM撤出雅典主要街區。後勤上，英軍重砲、戰車與燃料多由薩拉米斯等港口上岸，再以卡車送往科林斯和前線；ELAS則以分散糧食、彈藥與馬匹搬運維持山地支隊。
dataEn: The critical timeline ran as follows. On 27 February 1944, ELAS entered Tripoli, disrupted communications within the Peloponnese, and advanced toward Corinth. From 4 March, ELAS attacked Corinth. The British 4th Indian Division and Greek government forces counterattacked along the coastal Corinth-Xylokastro road and the Tripoli-Corinth road, with British naval gunfire and armoured vehicles supporting infantry and rapidly restoring control around Corinth. After 5 April, ELAS launched attacks on several axes around Edessa, Kalpaki, and eastern Macedonia. The British used the Edessa road, the Kalpaki pass, and the Salonika transport route as anchor points and reconnected their front and rear areas by late April. During the latter part of May and June, the British withdrew substantial personnel and equipment under Operation Cling. On 23 June, a decommissioning agreement was signed, most southern ELAS forces disbanded, and some Macedonian units refused to surrender their weapons. In September, the EAM was excluded from the London Conference, and on 3 October it ended participation in the government coalition, returning both sides to armed confrontation. On 3 December, clashes between EAM formations and the Greek security forces after an EAM gathering in Athens produced barricades across the city. On 21 and 22 December, an EAM force ambushed a British armoured evacuation column on the road toward Megara. An Anglo-Greek arrangement produced a ceasefire on 23 December, after which the EAM withdrew from the principal districts of Athens. Logistically, the British landed heavy artillery, tanks, and fuel at ports including Salamis and moved them by truck to Corinth and the forward areas. ELAS sustained its mountain formations through dispersed food and ammunition stocks and transport by pack animals.
cause: 衝突由政治競爭、軍事解除武裝和國際介入三條線索共同促成。1943年義大利在希臘的軍隊投降後，ELAS利用希臘王國軍隊解體及德軍尚未完全控制局面的機會擴張；10月5日的克利蘇拉山口戰役中，ELAS擊退義軍並延緩德軍與義軍殘部南進，繳獲的槍械、機車和軍需也擴大了武裝。英國最初把ELAS視為對付軸心軍的可用力量，隨著其控制城鎮、武器與地方行政而逐漸改為要求全面解除武裝。12月17日至24日，英軍裝甲車與希臘治安部隊包圍並強占雅典理工學院，EAM武裝人員撤離，雙方互信隨之崩潰。1944年2月，英國要求ELAS交出武器並退出城市、港口和主要交通線；ELAS若接受，便會失去現有部隊、補給來源與地方組織，遂先後控制特里波利斯、科林斯周邊及伯羅奔尼撒公路。南斯拉夫從邊境提供武器與訓練，使ELAS不願完全解除武裝；英國則以援助和軍事干預維持希臘中央政府，雙方對戰爭結果的預期差距遂轉化為1944年的全面武裝衝突。
causeEn: The conflict developed from three converging pressures: political rivalry, attempts to disarm the armed organizations, and direct international intervention. After the Italian forces in Greece capitulated in 1943, ELAS expanded while the Royal Hellenic Army had dissolved and German control remained incomplete. In the Battle of Klisura Pass on 5 October, ELAS defeated Italian troops and delayed the southward movement of German and Italian reinforcements; captured rifles, motorcycles, and supplies enlarged its armed capacity. Britain initially treated ELAS as a useful force against the Axis but gradually demanded complete demobilization as the organization gained control of towns, weapons, and local administration. Between 17 and 24 December, British armoured cars and Greek security forces surrounded and seized the Athens Polytechnic, from which EAM fighters withdrew, and mutual confidence collapsed. In February 1944, Britain required ELAS to surrender its weapons and leave the cities, ports, and principal transport routes. Acceptance would have deprived ELAS of its existing formations, supply sources, and local organization, so it moved in succession against Tripoli, the approaches to Corinth, and the Peloponnese road network. Support from Yugoslavia across the border gave ELAS an incentive not to disarm completely, while British aid and military intervention sustained the Greek central government. The difference between the two sides over the acceptable political outcome was thus converted into the armed conflict of 1944.
impact: 1944年最重要的結果不是ELAS全面潰散，而是其地理與政治力量被重新分割。解除武裝協定使政府軍恢復阿提卡通往伯羅奔尼撒的公路、鐵路與城鎮控制，南方ELAS大部放下武器；但拒絕解散的馬其頓與北方支隊仍保有完整武裝，EAM中央也由掌握南部轉為主要依賴山區。到12月23日，EAM失去雅典市區的主要街區與公開政治聯盟，察卡洛托斯等領導人轉入地下，英軍與希臘治安部隊則重新控制首都主要路口。這場失敗削弱了EAM在南方的組織與補給，卻未消滅北方的軍事能力。1945年後，衝突逐步轉化為希臘人民民主軍與政府軍的對抗；政府軍在1946年至1947年的攻勢未能消滅北部游擊力量，人民民主軍仍控制馬其頓與伊庇魯斯山區。1947年美國援助開始以軍火與經濟支持維持希臘政府，1948年南斯拉夫與共產國際決裂並收緊邊境援助，政府軍才得以在冬季攻勢中進入格拉莫斯與沃拉斯山區。人民民主軍的主要野戰單位於1949年2月前後被瓦解，殘部越境或分散從事小規模活動，內戰至此才真正結束。
impactEn: The most important result of 1944 was not the complete destruction of ELAS but the geographic and political division of its strength. The decommissioning agreement allowed the government to restore control of the roads, railways, and towns linking Attica with the Peloponnese, and most southern ELAS forces laid down their weapons. Macedonian and northern detachments that refused to disband nevertheless retained their weapons and organization, while the EAM center shifted from control of southern Greece to a predominantly mountain-based position. By 23 December, the EAM had lost the principal districts of Athens and its open political coalition. Tsakalotos and other leaders went underground, while British and Greek security forces regained the main approaches into the capital. This defeat damaged the EAM organization and supply system in the south but did not eliminate its military capacity in the north. After 1945, the struggle increasingly took the form of a confrontation between the Democratic Army of Greece and the government. Government offensives in 1946 and 1947 failed to destroy the insurgents in northern Greece, and the Democratic Army retained mountain areas in Macedonia and Epirus. American aid began supporting the Greek government with weapons and economic resources in 1947. Only after the Cominform split and the reduction of Yugoslav assistance in 1948 could government forces enter the Grammos and Voras mountain areas during a winter offensive. The principal field formations of the Democratic Army were destroyed around February 1949, after which surviving groups crossed the frontier or fragmented into smaller operations. The civil war then ended in its final sense.
result: 若以1944年12月23日為這場戰役的階段終點，結果是英國與希臘政府軍奪回雅典主要控制區，EAM從希臘政府的公開聯合陣線退位，南方ELAS依解除武裝協定解散，北方ELAS則保留武裝並在1946年後成為人民民主軍的基礎。因而1944年不能被寫成希臘內戰已經全面結束，它實際上完成了三項變化：政府重新掌握沿海交通與大城市，EAM由全國性政治力量縮入北部山區，英國的常駐部隊大部分撤回而改由武器、情報和援助影響戰局。1944年夏季，馬其頓與伯羅奔尼撒部分地方指揮官分別達成協議，使ELAS southern force further contracted. The decisive endpoint came in February 1949, when government troops occupied the last major Democratic Army positions around Grammos and Mount Voras, cut the remaining bands from their northern supply routes, and forced the organized communist force to dissolve or leave Greece. The final political result was therefore a government victory backed by British and later American assistance, restoration of royal authority and stronger central control, rather than a negotiated settlement giving the EAM or its successor a durable share of national power.
resultEn: If 23 December 1944 is treated as the stage endpoint of the campaign, the British and Greek government forces had regained the principal districts of Athens, the EAM had withdrawn from the Greek government coalition, and most southern ELAS units had disbanded under the decommissioning agreement, while northern ELAS formations retained their weapons and later provided the foundation of the Democratic Army of Greece. The civil war therefore did not end comprehensively in 1944. It completed three major changes: the government regained the coastal communications and major cities, the EAM contracted from a national political organization into the northern mountains, and most British troops departed Greece while British weapons, intelligence, and assistance continued to influence the campaign. During the summer of 1944, separate agreements with local commanders in Macedonia and the Peloponnese caused the southern ELAS force to contract further. The decisive endpoint came in February 1949, when government troops occupied the last major Democratic Army positions around Grammos and Mount Voras, cut the remaining bands from their northern supply routes, and forced the organized communist force to dissolve or leave Greece. The final political result was consequently a government victory backed first by Britain and later by the United States, the restoration of royal authority, and stronger central control, rather than a negotiated settlement granting the EAM or its successor a durable share of national power.
